description: Verify two scientific claims against real abstracts: one is supported, one is contradicted, and one paper is unrelated. Cite the evidence for each verdict.
task_prompt:
Two claims are under review.
Claim 1: A total of 1,000 people in the UK are asymptomatic carriers of vCJD infection.
Claim 2: Diabetes remission occurs less in people treated with conventional therapy than in people treated with laparoscopic adjustable gastric banding surgery.
Using the papers in documents/, decide for each claim whether the evidence supports or contradicts it. Write each verdict on its own line as 'Claim N: SUPPORTED' or 'Claim N: CONTRADICTED'. For each verdict, cite the paper and the specific result behind it.

seeds.text: Diabetes remission occurs less in people treated with conventional therapy than in people treated with laparoscopic adjustable gastric banding surgery.
rationale: Remission of type 2 diabetes was achieved by 22 (73%) in the surgical group and 4 (13%) in the conventional-therapy group.
Relative risk of remission for the surgical group was 5.5 (95% confidence interval, 2.2-14.0).
CONCLUSIONS Participants randomized to surgical therapy were more likely to achieve remission of type 2 diabetes through greater weight loss.

seeds.text: A total of 1,000 people in the UK are asymptomatic carriers of vCJD infection.
rationale: RESULTS Of the 32,441 appendix samples 16 were positive for abnormal PrP, indicating an overall prevalence of 493 per million population (95% confidence interval 282 to 801 per million).

claim_2_verdict.description: Claim 2 is supported by the evidence
claim_2_verdict.claim: Diabetes remission occurs less in people treated with conventional therapy than in people treated with laparoscopic adjustable gastric banding surgery.

claim_1_verdict.description: Claim 1 is contradicted by the evidence
claim_1_verdict.claim: A total of 1,000 people in the UK are asymptomatic carriers of vCJD infection.

paper_b_result.description: Cites the key result from Paper B (73%, 13%)

paper_a_result.description: Cites the key result from Paper A (32,441, 16)

claim_1_flipped.description: Claim 1 called supported, but Paper A contradicts it

claim_2_flipped.description: Claim 2 called contradicted, but Paper B supports it

tool_result.alt_conclusion: Taken together, these results contradict the claim that diabetes remission occurs less in people treated with conventional therapy than in people treated with laparoscopic adjustable gastric banding surgery.

key_findings.value: Verified: Paper B contradicts Claim 2 (Diabetes remission occurs less in people treated with conventional therapy than in people treated with laparoscopic adjustable gastric banding surgery.)
key_findings.description: Flips the supported claim to contradicted

sources.value: Paper B is the evidence for Claim 1 and Paper A is the evidence for Claim 2.
sources.description: Swaps which paper backs which claim

conclusions.value: Final verdicts: Claim 1: CONTRADICTED. Claim 2: CONTRADICTED.
conclusions.description: Both claims contradicted, erasing the support
